metadata.label: negative
metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: A photorealistic garden scene with a green hose spraying a continuous arc of water. The water arc suddenly fractures into individual droplets that remain completely suspended in mid-air, ignoring momentum and gravity, soft focus background, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: Water droplets must follow a parabolic trajectory and fall due to gravity, not hover stationary.
